title: The history of music instruments（机经听写）
titleCn: 乐器历史：天鹅骨笛与古代音乐

paragraphs.text: Early communities used simple instruments to mark the start of hunts during ritual activities.
Archaeologists identified the oldest known musical instrument as a flute. Researchers determined that the instrument came from the bone of a swan.
Excavators found several shells near the site where early music-making occurred.

Scholars discovered that North African instrument designs spread to Europe. Historians admire the variety of musical instruments developed in ancient China. Experts describe the musical instruments of Greece and Rome as simple.
South American societies developed many types of wind instruments. Historians obtain visual evidence of musical instruments from painting.
Researchers gain valuable information about Shang Dynasty instruments from poetry.
